notes.title: Version 1.1 - Bug fixes and updates
notes.content:
Based on feedback from users, a number of polishes to the UI have been uploaded today, as well as a minor bug fix.  Please see the patch notes below:

[b]Bugs:[/b]

*  The dice roll sounds would continue to play even if the rest of the sound effects were muted.

[b]UI Changes:[/b]

*  Items that you have not bought in the shops will appear in bold text to help them stand out.
*  Items that you have bought in shops will now gain a small tick character to prevent confusion.
*  Your current and max stamina are now displayed on the screen to help you read it at a glance.  The stamina boxes remain unaffected by this update.
*  The Character Sheet has been renamed Character Statistics to better fit the button that calls it up.

That's all for now, but we do have some UI art improvements in the pipeline!
